The abstract describes a framework for ultrasound video analysis that adds a training-free vision-language model and retrieval augmentation to verify uncertain predictions. That is a RAG-like component, since a VLM conditions on retrieved items. Experiments are run. However, the setting is multimodal (ultrasound video and images), which points to E9 (multimodal-only RAG). The retrieval is probably of image cases, so the RAG part is multimodal. The paper's main focus is not RAG, but it does include a retrieval-augmented VLM component. Under the rules, multimodal-only RAG is excluded. Whether the retrieved content includes text is unclear, so the case is uncertain, but the likeliest reading is multimodal retrieval with a VLM, which supports E9.

{"decision": "EXCLUDE", "code": "E9", "reason": "Retrieval augmentation with a vision-language model on ultrasound video; multimodal-only RAG."}
